messages:
devops: paging — canary rollout in us-west-2 failing health checks after secrets flip, endpoint inference-api-canary returning 500s, lots of timeouts :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — #4339876543 — Severity: P2 — Affected svc: inference-api (canary) — paging oncall

alex: on it, joining bridge. any customer hits yet?

cs-rep: getting a few reports, two enterprise customers seeing 500s in the last 5m, ticket numbers in support queue 3821,3822

sre-lead: +1, start triage. alex do we have logs from the canary hosts?

alex: grabbing logs. initial error looks like KMS decrypt failures when loading model keys. sample: `AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/inference-canary-role is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01`

devops: that would match the deploy — we rotated the key alias earlier and toggled `USE_KMS=True` env var in the canary deploy. maybe IAM role missing new key permissions

priya: can we flip the feature flag to stop traffic to canary while we investigate? we have a kill-switch documented.

alex: issuing flag kill now: `/ff set inference_canary.enabled false --org=redwood --reason="fail fast canary"` 

deploy-bot: Feature flag update queued — inference_canary.enabled -> false — applied in 3 regions. :white_check_mark:

cs-rep: traffic to canary dropped, customers reporting fewer errors, but some requests still hit cached nodes

alex: initiating immediate rollback of canary config change to previous env (fallback to USE_KMS=false):
```bash
deploy-bot rollback-config inference-api canary --env USE_KMS=false --note "fallback after KMS permission issue"
```

deploy-bot: rollback-config started — canary pool will restart with previous env in ~2m

sre-lead: also temp mitigation: set S3-hosted key fallback to plaintext (safe only for short window) and add rate limit to model load warmers

priya: 👍 performing on-call rotation/handoff in 30m, leaving followup tasks for infra. alex pls collect evidence for postmortem (timelines, config diff, affected customers)

alex: collecting diffs now: config changeset shows `KMS_ALIAS` updated from `alias/redwood-canary-v1` -> `alias/redwood-canary-rotated`; canary role policy missing `kms:Decrypt` for new key ARN (policy attached to role didn't include new key id)

devops: we should add an automated check in the deploy pipeline: when a KMS alias/key is changed, ensure affected roles have permissions or pause rollout. filing a short PR after incident

cs-rep: opened customer bridge with affected accounts, they want ETA. current mitigation restored service for most, ETA for full verification ~20m

alex: logs show successful loads starting at +6m after rollback. moving to monitoring for 20m window to ensure no regressions.

priya: handing off to night oncall (priya -> priya? actually alex will be primary for next hour then hand to priya at H+60). leaving checklist: 1) postmortem draft, 2) deploy pipeline check for KMS alias permissions, 3) follow up with security on key rotation runbook.

sre-lead: add runbook note: for future rotations, update role policy via CloudFormation change before alias swap or use key policy allowing `ssm`/`ec2` principal to decrypt instead of ad-hoc role edits.

alex: will draft postmortem and send to #incidents by EOD. marking incident as mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — #4339876543 — status: mitigated -> monitoring — duration 00:12:22 — responders: alex, priya, devops, sre-lead — customers impacted: 2 enterprise, 7 small accounts — followups assigned

priya: thanks team — nice quick kill-switch execution. leaving notes in the issue tracker. :thumbsup:
